name: Linear assigned work
tagline: Wake an agent when issues or projects assigned to you change
description: Checks Linear every minute for the issues assigned to one person in one team, and for the projects that person leads. It runs as a normal program with no AI, reads Linear's API directly with a personal API key, and never changes anything in Linear. A new item, or a change to an issue's title or description, wakes the agent once. Optional settings narrow the issues by workflow state or label, add the issues delegated to a Linear agent user, and watch comments. A state filter or a label filter also makes a change of state or labels wake the agent, and comments make a new or edited comment wake it. With none of these settings the check watches what version 1.0.0 watched. Changes you made yourself are skipped when the author can be told from Linear's history; when it cannot, the change is delivered. Linear's rate limits are honored with a saved cooldown for each check. Install it again for another workspace, team or person: every install has its own settings, API key, schedule and history.
accountLabelHint: The Linear workspace, for example Work

variables.name: LINEAR_API_TOKEN
variables.label: Linear personal API key
variables.hint: Create a personal API key in your Linear account settings (Security and access). Read-only access is enough. Paste it here after the install, never in chat.

configuration.name: instanceId
configuration.label: Instance name
configuration.description: A short name that is unique to this check, such as work-eng. It keeps the rate-limit cooldown of one check apart from another.

configuration.name: workspaceId
configuration.label: Workspace ID
configuration.description: The ID of the Linear workspace (organization). The check stops if the API key belongs to another workspace. Ask your agent to look it up with the Linear app.

configuration.name: workspaceSlug
configuration.label: Workspace URL key
configuration.description: The part after linear.app/ in your workspace address.

configuration.name: assigneeId
configuration.label: Your Linear user ID
configuration.description: The user whose assigned issues and led projects to watch. The API key must belong to this user.

configuration.name: assigneeEmail
configuration.label: Your Linear email
configuration.description: The email of that user. It is checked against the API key, so the check cannot read another account.

configuration.name: teamId
configuration.label: Team ID
configuration.description: The ID of the one team to watch.

configuration.name: teamKey
configuration.label: Team key
configuration.description: The short key of that team, such as ENG. It is checked against the team ID.

configuration.name: stateFilter
configuration.label: Workflow states (optional)
configuration.description: Watch only issues in these workflow states, with names separated by commas, such as Todo, In Progress. A move between these states wakes the agent. Leave empty to watch every state.

configuration.name: labelFilter
configuration.label: Labels (optional)
configuration.description: Watch only issues that have at least one of these labels, with names separated by commas. A label change wakes the agent. Leave empty to watch every issue.

configuration.name: delegateId
configuration.label: Delegate user ID (optional)
configuration.description: Also watch the issues that are delegated to this Linear user, such as an agent user. Leave empty to watch assigned issues only.

configuration.name: includeComments
configuration.label: Watch comments
configuration.description: Wake the agent when a recent comment on an issue is new or edited. The check then asks for at most 25 issues in each request.

configuration.name: includeProjects
configuration.label: Watch projects you lead
configuration.description: Also watch the projects that this user leads.

configuration.name: pageSize
configuration.label: Page size
configuration.description: How many items to ask for in each request, from 1 to 100.

instruction: New or changed Linear work that is assigned to me was found. Each item has an ID: i:<id> is an issue and p:<id> is a project I lead. The data holds only IDs, so read each item with the Linear app, work out what is new or changed, and tell me only if it needs my attention or action. Do not change anything in Linear unless I ask.
